title: BrowsePage: default order by title A-Z
goal: Make the catalogue list the books in the spec's default order (Title A-Z). Only the default order is in scope here; the Sort by control is a separate task.
spec: BRW-3: A control labelled "Sort by" orders the books by "Title A-Z" (the default), "Newest first" or "Oldest first" (by year).
